subject: Livewire post-cutover: sanity sweep, KV priming evidence & ops acceptance
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T08:12:00Z
Subject: Livewire post-cutover: sanity sweep, KV priming evidence & ops acceptance

Morning all —

Thanks again for moving traffic to the Livewire deployment overnight. This thread is the single-source ops acceptance for the cutover: a short checklist and asks so SRE, network, and Acme can sign off. Please respond inline with any blockers.

Immediate checklist (target: 2-hour window):
- Smoke generation: run 1k synthetic requests across the three VIPs (auth, inference, metrics). Report 95th latency and error rate.
- KV priming: confirm prefix cache hit rate and KV warmup complete. Attach tail of kv-priming log.
- Observability: confirm traces show end-to-end spans (ingress -> model -> storage) and no 5xx spikes in last 30m. Attach APM snapshot link.
- Failover validation: perform a single-node drain of one inference host and confirm traffic migrates within SLA window.
- Security: confirm ACLs applied to customer VPC and no unexpected inbound ports.

Deliverables to include in reply: short summary lines + attachment stubs (csv for smoke summary, txt log for kv priming). If all checks pass, we will close the activation and schedule a 1-week stability cadence.

Ops owner: Marissa Cole (will post smoke CSV)
Network POC: Rajiv (Acme)
SRE: Karthik Iyer

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference

Attachments: planned-checklist.pdf (xref)

Irene / Rajiv —

Quick results from the runs (summary; full CSV attached):
- Smoke: 1,024 synthetic requests across VIPs (auth/infer/metrics).
  - 95th latency (inference) = 142 ms
  - Error rate (4xx/5xx) = 0.3% (mostly a handful of auth 401s from stale tokens during replay)
  - Token throughput consistent with expected baseline (see CSV: livewire-smoke-summary-20280630.csv)
- KV priming:
  - Warmup completed in 18 minutes (primed ~1.2M prefix entries).
  - Post-warmup cache hit rate = 91.3%
  - See tail of kv-priming-log-20280630.txt for sample entry timings and any slow writes.
- Observability:
  - Traces show full E2E spans; APM snapshot uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-livewire-evidence
  - No 5xx spikes in the last 45 minutes; small burst of auth 401s at 09:12 correlating to token rotation (investigating)
- Failover validation:
  - Drained one inference host (node-infer-03); traffic shifted to remaining pool in 22s. No request loss observed beyond brief reconnects.
- Security:
  - Verified ACLs against ACME-VPC-Livewire; only expected ports open.

Conclusion: All core checks pass. Action items for next 24h:
- Karthik to run one more KV priming sanity at 02:00 PT (night cadence) and paste logs if anything regresses.
- Acme to confirm acceptance of auth token rotation behavior (Rajiv).
- Schedule 1-week stability checkpoint (Irene) — propose Tue 07/03 10:00 PT.

Attachments:
- livewire-smoke-summary-20280630.csv (text/csv)
- kv-priming-log-20280630.txt (text/plain)
